baselineAddition: Pinned main adds the public side and one-based line address to the opaque painter; the older stable tree exposes only render().
invariants: paint resolves only through a split row's canonical or alias stable key
each requested side is adapted into a full-width stack row without wrapping or selection paint
an absent split side becomes an explicit blank context row
move kind, syntax spans, line-number setting, horizontal offset, width, and theme survive adaptation
accepted paint is scoped to the exact file and cursor identity that produced it
pending and unavailable lifecycle updates clear stale paint immediately

nativeAdaptation.renderer: ExtensionCurrentLineRenderedRow is the owned Ratatui row-render input replacing a React element callback result
nativeAdaptation.identity: Arc state preserves Hunk's equal-empty update identity without shared mutable objects
